name: SchemaVersion
description: Export layout version; must be 1

name: Heartbeat
description: Changes while the monitor executes; not proof of robot communication

name: MonitorState
description: 0 unqualified, 1 waiting/between, 2 cycle active

name: CurrentShift
description: 0 gap or invalid clock; 1 day; 2 night

name: CyclesThisHour
description: Completed cycles in the current calendar hour

name: CyclesPreviousHour
description: Last observed closed hour; use its key and partial flag

name: Shift1Current
description: Current/latest day-shift running count

name: Shift1Previous
description: Most recently closed day-shift count

name: Shift2Current
description: Current/latest night-shift running count

name: Shift2Previous
description: Most recently closed night-shift count

name: PreviousCycleSeconds
description: Held duration of the last valid completed cycle

name: BetweenCycleSeconds
description: Live waiting duration after a known completion; check BetweenActive

name: PreviousBetweenSeconds
description: Held waiting duration captured at the next accepted start

name: CycleSeconds
description: Live active-cycle duration, diagnostic

name: ThisHourKey
description: Days since 1990-01-01 multiplied by 24, plus local hour

name: PreviousHourKey
description: Identity of the held hour; -1 means no held hour

name: Shift1Day
description: Day-shift start date, days since 1990-01-01

name: Shift1PreviousDay
description: Held day-shift start date; -1 means none

name: Shift2Day
description: Night-shift START date, including after midnight

name: Shift2PreviousDay
description: Held night-shift start date; -1 means none

name: PreviousCycleValid
description: 1 once a valid completion has populated the held cycle

name: PreviousBetweenValid
description: 1 once a known interval has been captured

name: ThisHourPartial
description: 1 means this hour is incomplete or uncertain

name: PreviousHourPartial
description: 1 means held hour is not a complete trusted hour

name: Shift1Partial
description: Day-shift current completeness flag

name: Shift1PreviousPartial
description: Held day-shift completeness flag

name: Shift2Partial
description: Night-shift current completeness flag

name: Shift2PreviousPartial
description: Held night-shift completeness flag

name: SignalsValid
description: Input/robot communication qualification supplied by site logic

name: ClockValid
description: Valid local calendar supplied by clock adapter

name: CycleActive
description: 1 while a qualified cycle is being observed

name: BetweenActive
description: 1 while live between-cycle duration is known

name: TimingFault
description: Latched restart/tick discontinuity or elapsed-counter saturation

name: TotalCompleted
description: All accepted completed cycles, including gap/clock-unassigned

name: GapCompleted
description: Completions in 06:00–06:30 gap

name: ClockUnassigned
description: Completions while local clock unavailable

name: ClockReview
description: Latched invalid clock/discontinuity; review period completeness

name: CounterSaturated
description: A reporting counter reached DINT maximum; never wraps

name: ObserverEnable
description: Commissioning enable: default 0; ONLY set this new DB field to 1 after review
